# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.
- Mira requested on 2026-10-22: "Please get this one done today." Requested completion date: 2026-10-22.

## Cadence selection

Use `daily`, following the accepted ruling below. Issue #31's weekly request predates the current ruling; ADR 0002 was superseded by ADR 0014, which was superseded by ADR 0023. Feature implementation remains pending.

Verified governing reference (also Accepted at the decision repository's current HEAD):

- Repository: https://github.com/example/mira-decisions.git (local clone: ../mira-decisions)
- Path: docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
